title: Resolution urging Congress to pass the Major Richard Star Act
summary: This resolution calls on the U.S. Congress to pass and the President to sign H.R. 2102/S. 1032, the Major Richard Star Act. The bill would let combat-injured veterans medically retired under Chapter 61 receive both full military retirement pay and VA disability compensation without an offset, ending what advocates call the "wounded veteran tax." It is named for Major Richard Star, who died in 2021 after advocating for the reform.
